opening_hook: Subah alarm baja, Aarav ne snooze dabaya. Kal se padhunga, usne khud se kaha.
narration: Subah alarm baja, Aarav ne snooze dabaya. Kal se padhunga, usne khud se kaha. Exam paas tha, kitaab saamne thi, par pehla page kholna mushkil lag raha tha. Phone phir chamka. Woh scroll karne hi wala tha, phir apna timetable dekha. Is baar phone side rakha aur sirf ek page padha. Das minute beet gaye. Page khatam hua. Sab kuch solve nahi hua, par usne kal ka wait bhi nahi kiya. Discipline shuru hota hai aaj ke ek chhote promise se.
